$comment: Named, reusable camera move snippets. In a shot's camera block use {"preset": "hero-orbit", "target": "doctor.head"}; explicit keys override preset keys. Distances in meters, angles in degrees.

hero-orbit.purpose: Introduce a character with weight: slow 3/4 orbit at eye level.

portrait-revolve.purpose: Intimate face study while a key idea lands.

object-inspection.purpose: Reveal an object's form (microscope, award, document).

monument-revolve.purpose: Establish scale of an architectural landmark.

rising-spiral.purpose: Escalation / reveal of a system or crowd.

descending-spiral.purpose: Descend into a problem; tighten focus.

slow-push.purpose: Growing tension / attention on a subject.

pull-reveal.purpose: Pull back to reveal context or isolation.

crane-up-reveal.purpose: Rise above a scene to reveal its geography.

crane-down-settle.purpose: Settle into a scene from above.

lateral-track.purpose: Parallax past foreground pillars; occlusion wipes.

corridor-glide.purpose: Journey / passage of time through architecture.

focus-breath.purpose: Quiet emphasis without big motion (still moves).
